daily.topThemeBody: Two independent studies published within a day of each other — one on U.S. district edtech, one on Ghanaian foundational learning — reach the same conclusion: the plan is not the problem. Administrators believe the readiness conditions are met; the people expected to deliver report constraints, unanswered questions and no support to translate policy into practice.
